title: Masked Mandates: artifact (code, scripts and results)
description: Rust prototype, Python bindings, MCP harness, simulators, result files (with environment record and SHA-256 hashes) and the script that generates every number, table and figure of the paper Masked Mandates: Unlinkable, Attenuable and Accountable Delegation for LLM Agents (submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security). Research prototype; not for production use. Code under MIT; result files and generated tables and figures under CC BY 4.0.

creators.name: Ameur, Yulliwas
creators.affiliation: Efrei Research Lab, Université Paris-Panthéon-Assas; Cédric, Cnam
